units.source_text: 且说二月二十日过后，藤壶公主举行着裳仪式。

en.t: After the twentieth day of the second month had passed, Princess Fujitsubo held her coming-of-age robing ceremony.

units.source_text: 次日薰大将即入赘，这一晚的事是不公开的。

en.t: The next day, General Kaoru immediately entered the family as her husband, though the events of that night were not made public.

units.source_text: 世间也有讥评此事的人，他们说：

en.t: There were also people in society who criticized the matter, saying:

units.source_text: “天下闻名、宠爱无比的皇女，招赘一个臣下为女婿，

en.t: “For an imperial princess, famous throughout the realm and loved beyond compare, to take a subject as her husband,

units.source_text: 毕竟是很不相称而又委屈的。

en.t: is, after all, quite ill-matched and unfair to her.

units.source_text: 即使今上已将公主许嫁薰大将，也不必如此匆匆成婚。”

en.t: Even if His Majesty has promised the princess to General Kaoru, there was no need to hurry the marriage so much.”

units.source_text: 但今上的个性，凡事一经决定，必须赶快实行。

en.t: But it was His Majesty’s nature that once he decided on something, he had to carry it out at once.

units.source_text: 今既招赘薰大将为驸马，便一心一意爱护这女婿，

en.t: Now that he had brought General Kaoru in as his son-in-law, he devoted himself wholeheartedly to cherishing him,

units.source_text: 恩遇之深，古来竟无其例。

en.t: and the depth of his favor was without precedent since ancient times.

units.source_text: 入帝王家当女婿的，古往今来，不乏其人。

en.t: From ancient times to the present, there had been no shortage of men who married into imperial families.

units.source_text: 但今上现正春秋鼎盛，而迫不及待地招赘一个类似臣下的人为婿，

en.t: But for the reigning Emperor, still in the prime of life, to be so impatient to take someone like a subject as his son-in-law,
was something for which there were few examples.

units.source_text: 所以夕雾左大臣对落叶公主说：

en.t: So the Left Minister Yugiri said to Princess Ochiba:

units.source_text: “薰大将如此深蒙圣眷，乃世间罕有之事，

en.t: “For General Kaoru to receive such deep imperial favor is a rare thing in this world,
and it must surely be a bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 六条院先父，尚且要到朱雀院晚年将近出家之时，

en.t: Even my late father, Rokujoin, had to wait until Suzakuin was in his later years and about to take religious vows,

units.source_text: 才娶得薰大将的母亲三公主呢。

en.t: before he could marry the Third Princess, General Kaoru’s mother.

units.source_text: 我更不必说了，只在别人反对声中拾得了你这位公主。”

en.t: As for me, there is even less to say; amid everyone’s objections, I merely managed to gain you, my princess.”

units.source_text: 落叶公主觉得确是如此，但因怕羞，默默不答。

en.t: Princess Ochiba felt that this was indeed true, but out of shyness she remained silent and gave no reply.
